main.description: Re-publish the head of an epoch the caller's mailbox already holds. Heads enter the directory only through createEpoch, atomically; this endpoint can neither introduce an epoch nor claim the next number. The caller must hold a bound Labyrinth device, the epoch must exist with exactly this epochPublic, and its attestation must be by the calling chat device's own key. Identical bytes succeed again. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
